title: Fix Body spline spacing epsilon unit mismatch
description:
Correct BodySplineAuthoring degenerate-spacing guards that compare the squared-direction epsilon MinSpacingSqr against linear distances. Introduce an explicit linear threshold tied to GenerationTolerances.MinBodySegmentLength, keep squared comparisons using the squared threshold, and add focused regression coverage for near-coincident append/prepend/respace paths.

## Reconciliation
Renumbered from TSK-0153 on 2026-09-12 because TSK-0153 was shared with the live ground-contact placement task (tsk-0153-rest-ground-contact-normalize-initial-creature-placement). This archived record is retained for provenance; TSK-0153 now resolves uniquely on this branch.

comments.author: Agent
comments.body: Created from the 2026-09-09 eleven-audit takeover synthesis. Repeated audits independently identified MinSpacingSqr as a squared-magnitude epsilon while several BodySplineAuthoring branches compare it to linear magnitudes/distances. The highest-confidence low-risk correction is to make linear-vs-squared units explicit rather than changing the tolerance value arbitrarily. Implementation is intentionally separate from the larger ResolvedPolyline/anatomical-rig work because those require broader planning and validation.
